measures.name: Hires Running Total
measures.expression: CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNTNOBLANK('employees.csv'[Employee ID]), WINDOW(1, ABS, 0, REL, CALCULATETABLE(SUMMARIZE('employees.csv', 'employees.csv'[Hire Year]), ALLSELECTED('employees.csv'[Hire Year])), ORDERBY('employees.csv'[Hire Year])))

tables.name: employees.csv
tables.m:
let
    Source = File.Contents(#"Employees File"),
    Csv = Csv.Document(Source, [Delimiter = ",", Encoding = 65001, QuoteStyle = QuoteStyle.Csv]),
    Data = Table.PromoteHeaders(Csv, [PromoteAllScalars = true]),
    Selected = Table.SelectColumns(Data, {"employee_id", "employee_name", "department", "job_level", "gender", "location", "hire_date", "termination_date", "salary", "performance_score"}, MissingField.UseNull),
    Renamed = Table.RenameColumns(Selected, {{"employee_id", "Employee ID"}, {"employee_name", "Employee Name"}, {"department", "Department"}, {"job_level", "Job Level"}, {"gender", "Gender"}, {"location", "Location"}, {"hire_date", "Hire Date"}, {"termination_date", "Termination Date"}, {"salary", "Salary"}, {"performance_score", "Performance Score"}}),
    Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Renamed, {{"Employee ID", type text}, {"Employee Name", type text}, {"Department", type text}, {"Job Level", type text}, {"Gender", type text}, {"Location", type text}, {"Hire Date", type date}, {"Termination Date", type date}, {"Salary", type number}, {"Performance Score", Int64.Type}})
in
    Typed

columns.name: Tenure Years
columns.expression: DIVIDE(DATEDIFF('employees.csv'[Hire Date], COALESCE('employees.csv'[Termination Date], DATE(2025, 12, 31)), DAY), 365.25)

columns.name: Tenure Band
columns.expression:
SWITCH(TRUE(),
        ('employees.csv'[Tenure Years] < 2), "0-2 yrs",
        ('employees.csv'[Tenure Years] < 5), "2-5 yrs",
        "5+ yrs"
    )

tables.name: Date
tables.dax_source: ADDCOLUMNS(CALENDARAUTO(), "Year", YEAR([Date]), "Quarter", "Q" & QUARTER([Date]), "Month Number", MONTH([Date]), "Month", FORMAT([Date], "MMM"), "Month Start", DATE(YEAR([Date]), MONTH([Date]), 1))

calculations.tableau_formula: SUM(IF NOT ISNULL([Termination Date]) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNTD([Employee ID])

calculations.dax: DIVIDE(DATEDIFF('employees.csv'[Hire Date], COALESCE('employees.csv'[Termination Date], DATE(2025, 12, 31)), DAY), 365.25)

calculations.tableau_formula: IF [Tenure Years] < 2 THEN '0-2 yrs' ELSEIF [Tenure Years] < 5 THEN '2-5 yrs' ELSE '5+ yrs' END
calculations.dax:

    )

CALCULATE(DISTINCTCOUNTNOBLANK('employees.csv'[Employee ID]), WINDOW(1, ABS, 0, REL, CALCULATETABLE(SUMMARIZE('employees.csv', 'employees.csv'[Hire Year]), ALLSELECTED('employees.csv'[Hire Year])), ORDERBY('employees.csv'[Hire Year])))

data.dax_query:
EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'employees.csv'[Department],
    "Headcount", [Headcount],
    "Attrition Rate", [Attrition Rate],
    "Median Salary", [Median Salary]
)
ORDER BY 'employees.csv'[Department]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'employees.csv'[Tenure Band],
    'employees.csv'[Is Active],
    "Headcount", [Headcount],
    "Average of Tenure Years", [Average of Tenure Years]
)
ORDER BY 'employees.csv'[Tenure Band], 'employees.csv'[Is Active]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'employees.csv'[Department],
    'employees.csv'[Job Level],
    KEEPFILTERS(TREATAS({"Austin", "Seattle"}, 'employees.csv'[Location])),
    "Average of Salary", [Average of Salary],
    "Salary vs Dept", [Salary vs Dept],
    "Average of Performance Score", [Average of Performance Score]
)
ORDER BY 'employees.csv'[Department], 'employees.csv'[Job Level]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'employees.csv'[Hire Year],
    "Headcount", [Headcount],
    "Hires Running Total", [Hires Running Total]
)
ORDER BY 'employees.csv'[Hire Year]

EVALUATE
SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
    'employees.csv'[High Performer],
    KEEPFILTERS(FILTER(ALL('employees.csv'[Department]), NOT('employees.csv'[Department] IN {"HR"}))),
    "Count of Employee ID", [Count of Employee ID]
)
ORDER BY 'employees.csv'[High Performer]
